$comment: SealLink v1.0 Structured Capability & Constraint Algebra Registry (SPEC-01, SPEC-06). All 7 predicates have linear-time decidable conservative subsumption (child <= parent) with zero Turing-completeness.

predicates.description: Exact equality against a scalar argument value.

predicates.narrowing_rule: (child.op == 'in' and set(child.operand) <= set(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'eq' and child.operand in set(parent.operand))
predicates.description: Finite allowlist of exact permitted values.

predicates.narrowing_rule: (child.op == 'not_in' and set(parent.operand) <= set(child.operand)) or (child.op == 'in' and set(child.operand).isdisjoint(set(parent.operand))) or (child.op == 'eq' and child.operand not in set(parent.operand))

(child.op == 'prefix' and child.operand.startswith(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'eq' and child.operand.startswith(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'in' and all(v.startswith(parent.operand) for v in child.operand))
predicates.description: Exact code-point prefix match (paths, git refs, URI hierarchies).

predicates.narrowing_rule: (child.op == 'suffix' and child.operand.endswith(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'eq' and child.operand.endswith(parent.operand)) or (child.op == 'in' and all(v.endswith(parent.operand) for v in child.operand))
predicates.description: Exact code-point suffix match (DNS domains, email/XMPP addresses).

operand_types: [uint64_str min, uint64_str max] with min <= max
predicates.narrowing_rule: (child.op == 'range' and parent.min <= child.min <= child.max <= parent.max) or (child.op == 'eq' and parent.min <= int(child.operand) <= parent.max) or (child.op == 'in' and all(parent.min <= int(v) <= parent.max for v in child.operand))
predicates.description: Closed unsigned 64-bit integer interval [min, max] (per-request amounts, sizes, hours, depths).
Exact 32-byte SHA-256 commitment match (config manifests, document payloads, templates).

quota_windows.description: Cumulative ceiling across the entire grant validity window.
Half-open block windows anchored at grant not_before_height.
UTC epoch-aligned fixed clock windows with durable regression watermark.

standard_quota_kinds.unit: requests | messages | bytes | operations | starts | calls
